name: golden-finger
description: Golden Finger for Codex — semantic confirmations, original-first-option answers, one-time consent and exact local command execution for the Yes工程师 workflow.

interface.shortDescription: 人机授权中继：Yes工程师的一键确认与命令授权窗口
interface.longDescription: Codex金手指（Golden Finger for Codex）是 Yes工程师的人机授权中继。它按完整语义把普通确认、审批和有序选项问询交给独立窗口，不依赖关键词或源参数类型；同意选择原始第一项。窗口冻结并显示问题、选项及按钮映射，返回结构化答案、单次授权或执行精确命令。支持用户点击和窗口配置的自动审批，自动回执不代表人工点击；当前 Codex 回合持续轮询到终态。
capabilities: Non-click-through Codex-themed 60% acrylic window with fully opaque text
Latest-request foreground and optional sound alerts
Responsive minimum-size layout with a fixed approval bar
Bounded short polling with a monotonic request deadline and an immediate in-window stop
Per-request capability claiming across concurrent projects
Human-readable project/task origin labels plus a non-secret connector fingerprint
Exact connector/Broker version and build handshake
Executable and direct-script SHA-256 re-verification before launch
Self-contained Windows EXE release build and clean-machine verification
Semantic yes/no and ordered single-select question routing, independent of keywords and source parameter types
User-global plugin runtime with first-use routing scopes and structured start-window or cancel-scope recovery
Typed answers preserving original question, negation, option IDs and first-option order
defaultPrompt: 使用 Codex金手指按语义处理审批与问询；同意选择原始第一项。首次先约定作用域并检查窗口；pending/running 按响应参数轮询到终态。
